name: Dark Folk
description: Aeolian folk loop, the murder-ballad four-chord cell that Henry Lee and The Curse of Millhaven share note for note (Am Dm G C). No functional dominant; the tonic is reached plagally and through the relative major.
source: Nick Cave & the Bad Seeds, via Ultimate Guitar chord sheets (Henry Lee, The Curse of Millhaven, Where the Wild Roses Grow)
